assessments.name: Placement Attendance
assessments.description: Attendance at classes and activities that contribute to placement hours.

assessments.name: Individual Assessment 1 - Professional Development Goals and Plan
assessments.description: An individual task that emphasises critical self-reflection on your role and contributions during fieldwork

assessments.name: Group Assessment 1 - Project Brief
assessments.description: A brief document (plus appendices) that outlines the scope, logic, and timeline of the community-based project.

assessments.name: Group Presentation
assessments.description: In-class Group Presentation - a professional oral presentation where the group provides an overview of their project, including the issue addressed, the processes undertaken, and the anticipated outcomes or impact of their deliverable

assessments.name: Individual Assessment 2 - Professional Development Report
assessments.description: This is an individual assessment task that requires students to critically report on their professional development outcomes as a result of participating in a community-based fieldwork project.

assessments.name: Group Assessment 2 - High Quality Deliverable
assessments.description:
Submit the High-Quality Deliverable to both the community partner and the instructors. 
Include a cover letter or explanatory note.
